en-GB.name: Tonight
en-GB.summary: Search everything on your streaming apps on the TV.
en-GB.description: Private skill: searches the TONIGHT. app's index of every film and series on your streaming apps, and shows the results on the TV.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Tonight to search for Inception
Alexa, ask Tonight to find Stranger Things

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Private skill for the developer's own TV.
